en: Psalms 31
For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

ja: 指揮者のために。ダビデの詩。

p.src: 1  In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

ja: を見ることのないようにしてください。 あなたの
en: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
u.src: 1  In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

p.src: 2  Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

ja: を助け出してください。 私のための強い岩となり、
en: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.
u.src: 2  Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

p.src: 3  For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

ja: だからだ。 それゆえ、
en: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
u.src: 3  For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

p.src: 4  Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

ja: き抜いてください。 あなたは
en: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
u.src: 4  Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

p.src: 5  Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.

ja: ってくださる。主よ、真理の神よ。
en: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.
u.src: 5  Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.

p.src: 6  I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.

en: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.
u.src: 6  I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.

p.src: 7  I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

ja: しみを見られたからだ。 あなたは
を心に留めてくださった。
en: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
u.src: 7  I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

p.src: 8  You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

en: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
u.src: 8  You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

p.src: 9  Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

ja: をあわれんでください。
も、私の体も、悲しみのゆえに衰え
en: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
u.src: 9  Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

p.src: 10  For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

ja: るからだ。 私の不義のゆえに、
en: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.
u.src: 10  For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

p.src: 11  Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

ja: のゆえに、私は隣人からひどくさげすまれ、
en: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.
u.src: 11  Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

p.src: 12  I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

en: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
u.src: 12  I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

p.src: 13  For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

ja: き、恐怖が四方を囲んでいるからだ。
en: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.
u.src: 13  For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

p.src: 14  But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”

en: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”
u.src: 14  But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”

p.src: 15  My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

en: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
u.src: 15  My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

p.src: 16  Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

ja: を照らしてください。 あなたの
en: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.
u.src: 16  Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

p.src: 17  Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

ja: じ入らせないでください。
じ入らせてください。彼らをよみ で黙らせてください。
en: Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.
u.src: 17  Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

ja: 31:17 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 31:17 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 18  Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

ja: 慢と軽蔑をもって、義人に逆らって横柄に
en: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
u.src: 18  Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

p.src: 19  Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

ja: きいことか。 あなたはそれを、あなたを恐れ敬う者たちのために蓄え、 人の子らの前で、あなたに身を避ける者たちのために行われた。
en: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!
u.src: 19  Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

p.src: 20  In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

ja: らを人の企てから、あなたの
れ場に隠される。 あなたは彼らを言葉の
れた住まいに、ひそかに
en: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.
u.src: 20  In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

p.src: 21  Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

ja: はほめたたえられますように。
en: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.
u.src: 21  Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

p.src: 22  As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

ja: ち切られた」と。 それでも、
en: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
u.src: 22  As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

p.src: 23  Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

ja: を愛せよ、主のすべての
を保ち、 傲慢にふるまう
en: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.
u.src: 23  Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

p.src: 24  Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.

ja: 強くあれ。あなたがたの心を奮い立たせよ。
en: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
u.src: 24  Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
